name: RetrieveDocuments
description: Performs a vector similarity search on the configured vector store to retrieve the most relevant records based on a given text prompt.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: vectorStore
fields.label: Vector Store
fields.description: Select the vector database provider used for storing and searching embeddings.

selectOptions.label: pgvector
selectOptions.description: PostgreSQL extension for vector similarity search

selectOptions.label: qdrant
selectOptions.description: Open-source vector database optimized for embeddings and semantic search

fields.name: inputText
fields.label: Input Text
fields.description: Enter the text to generate embeddings and perform a similarity search.
fields.placeholder: Type the text you want to search for...

fields.name: searchFilterType
fields.label: Search or Filter By
fields.description: Choose how the search should be filtered.

selectOptions.label: Both
selectOptions.description: Filter using both document names and knowledge base names

fields.name: documentNames
fields.label: Document Names
fields.description: Enter one or more document names, separated by commas.

fields.name: knowledgeBaseNames
fields.label: Knowledge Base Names
fields.description: Enter one or more knowledge base names, separated by commas.
fields.placeholder: e.g. HR Policies, Product Docs, Support Articles

fields.name: numberOfChunks
fields.label: Number of Chunks
fields.description: Specify the maximum number of similar records to return.

fields.name: scoreThreshold
fields.label: Score Threshold
fields.description: Set the minimum similarity score required to return matching results.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__Embedding
fields.label: Embedding Model
fields.description: Select the embedding model configuration used to generate vector embeddings from the input text.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the top matching records ranked by similarity to the input text.
